L4_saturation.note: logistic saturation is MILD when p in [0.5, 0.9]: the sigmoid derivative p(1-p) stays >= ~0.09; saturation can only explain score flattening between ALREADY-similar z values, not the identity of those values

D1_layers.score_scale_note: score = 100*p; reported score rounding to 0.1 makes any dZ < ~0.001 invisible in the final score

D2_correlation.effective_dim_note: effective independent dimension among the 9 hub positives = matrix rank of their raw feature matrix

D3_sub_morphology.readout_note: a bucket whose members span multiple families/structures can only collapse if the KEPT features cannot see the difference — cross-check with D1 blind classes

D4_candidate_ranking.delivery_rule: certificate grade best > crossed-certified > second > uncertified, tie-break crossings asc, then score desc (delivery never reads the aesthetic score — by design)
